summary: Checked all 4 acceptance checks by running the built ./tally binary: the dash-project line is rejected on stdin and as a file argument with exit 1; valid timesheets, including my-site, still total wi…
Before the fix the same input printed a '-' row and exited 0; after the fix it is rejected at line 2.

blocks.caption: Before the fix (parent 1436e4a): '2026-11-20 - 45m' is totalled as a project named '-' and the exit status is 0
Acceptance check 1: on stdin, the dash-project line prints nothing on stdout, 'tally: line 2: "-" is not a project name like site' on stderr, and exits 1
Acceptance check 2: the same two lines given as a file argument print the same stderr message and exit 1
Acceptance check 3: a valid timesheet with my-site still totals (site 1h30m, my-site 0h45m) and exits 0, via stdin and via a file
Acceptance check 4: go vet ./... passes and go test ./... passes, including the new dash test; the same test fails against the pre-fix tally.go
Edge cases: --project my-site still works, a dash on line 1 is rejected as line 1, and a normal site line still totals
